caption: All 24 constructors and all three fixed final seeds. Points are individual seeds, central markers are seed means, and vertical spans are seed ranges, not inferential intervals. S01 denotes the prescribed statistical reference. A star denotes an incomplete constructor endpoint. Grey shading is the original case-specific reference interval, not an equivalence margin or population truth. Cases use different measurement units, selection and weighting. HbA1c effects are percentage-point differences per stated predictor unit. Separate panels must not be pooled as an accuracy score.
